name: Update static assets

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/update.yml'
  workflow_dispatch: {} # Used to manually trigger a nightly build.
  schedule:
    # Run on 1st and 15th of each month
    - cron: '1 2 1,15 * *'

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '22'

jobs:
  update:
    name: Update static assets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: develop
      - name: Enable Yarn 4.x
        run: corepack enable
      - name: Setup NodeJS ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'yarn'
      # The scripts require some modules that we need to install.
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --immutable
      - name: Config git
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
      # Update CSL files
      - name: Update CSL files
        run: |
          yarn update:csl
          git add -A
          git diff-index --quiet HEAD || git commit -m "chore(citeproc): Update CSL files"
      # Update the CITATION.cff file if applicable
      - name: Update CITATION.cff
        run: |
          yarn update:citation
          git add -A
          git diff-index --quiet HEAD || git commit -m "Update CITATION.cff"
      # Test to make sure we don't break anything
      - name: Test build
        run: yarn test
      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v1.0.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: develop

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
